data.body:
[P3] Restrict slash stripping to hidden-class suffixes

`wrapperName` also passes externally supplied callback and invoke error types through this helper. An external type such as `payments/v1.PaymentError` consequently becomes `payments`, although the shared reduction rule yields `PaymentError`. This loses the actual failure identity and breaks cross-SDK grouping. Strip only recognized Java hidden-class address suffixes; otherwise apply `simpleTypeName` to the complete string. Add callback/invoke coverage for external types containing `/`.
